finding: The 33.69 s baseline is dominated by CPU prompt processing and generation for a 1.5B local model. Lower output size and keep-alive reduce a short BriefNext call to 28.18 s, but a longer Handoff prompt remains slow. Correctness and citation validation were preserved.
